description: NaNi₂H₃(SO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.79 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.12 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.18 Å) and one longer (1.21 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.52 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ni and two H atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONi₂H₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ni and two H atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONi₂H₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one S atom.
